# openMCP (meok-cross-post)

> One CLI to audit a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server against a 100-point rubric and cross-post it to every top directory: Smithery, Glama, MCPize, PulseMCP, the MCP Registry, and the Docker MCP Catalog. It pushes to the directories with public APIs (Smithery, MCP Registry) and prints an exact manual checklist for the rest. Apache-2.0, Python 3.10+. By MEOK AI Labs (CSOAI-ORG).

## What it is

meok-cross-post scores a flagship MCP repo 0-100 across five categories, then automates the listings that have public APIs and generates copy-paste checklists (and a ready-to-PR Docker YAML) for the ones that don't.

## The 100-point rubric (5 categories)

- A. Package installability (25): pyproject.toml, hatchling, only-include, mcp>=1.0.0, scripts entry, wheel builds.
- B. Server correctness (25): server.py imports, mcp object, >=3 docstringed tools, auth_middleware.py, real tests.
- C. Discovery & directories (25): smithery.yaml (declarative), server.json, server-card.json, glama.json, package.json.
- D. Distribution & ops (15): Dockerfile.glama, mcp-wrapper.py, public GHCR image, listed on Smithery + MCP Registry.
- E. CI/CD & docs (10): test/ci/publish workflows, README install+features+license, SECURITY.md.
- Merge gate: total >= 80 AND every per-category minimum satisfied.

## Commands

- `meok-cross-post audit <path>` : local-only 0-100 scorecard (markdown or --format json).
- `meok-cross-post audit <path> --network` : adds GHCR / Smithery / MCP Registry probes.
- `meok-cross-post cross-post <path>` : push metadata to Smithery + MCP Registry (idempotent).
- `meok-cross-post checklist <path>` : manual directory-submission checklist.
- `meok-cross-post all <path>` : audit -> cross-post -> checklist.

## Directories covered

Automated (public API): Smithery, MCP Registry. Manual checklist (no public API): Docker MCP Catalog, Glama, MCPize, PulseMCP.

## Install

- `pip install meok-cross-post`
- `uvx --from meok-cross-post meok-cross-post audit <path>`

## MCP server

Streamable-http (default http://localhost:8000/mcp); run `openmcp`. Tools: audit_repo, cross_post_metadata, manual_checklist.
